instruction: Please help me generate a complete architectural diagram showing the relationships between all code elements in the current Python file.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because generating an architectural diagram requires subjective decisions about what relationships to show, at what level of abstraction, and in what visual format. There's no objective way to validate whether a diagram is 'complete' or accurately represents the relationships, as different visualizations could all be considered correct depending on the intended audience and purpose.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - generating a 'complete architectural diagram' is inherently subjective
The instruction requires subjective decisions: what constitutes 'complete', which relationships to show, what level of abstraction, and which visual format to use
No objective automated verification is possible - different diagram styles (UML, flowchart, dependency graph, etc.) could all be considered correct
The explanation provided accurately describes why this task cannot be objectively verified
The 'infeasible' evaluator function is the appropriate choice for this type of creative/visual task
